blocks.text: READ: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—University of the Philippines clamped down defensively in the second half to pull away from Ateneo, 94-75, and remain unbeaten in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament Saturday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. The Fighting Maroons improved to 2-0 after following up their opening-day victory over University of Santo Tomas with another win, this time against their Katipunan rivals. But UP had to work for it. The Maroons held just a 57-56 lead at halftime before tightening their defense, particularly against Kieffer Alas, and taking control after the break. “We […]...
